rules: Fatal Potential is always rated High risk and closed the same day or next day.
Medium risk: closure target about two weeks. Low risk: about 30 days.
Unsafe conditions need a corrective action plan; unsafe acts are closed by correcting the behaviour on the spot.
The responsible function follows the hazard: electrical faults to Electrical, guards and leaks to Mechanical, housekeeping and passage obstruction to Operations, structural repairs to Civil.

cases.obs: Excess packaging material kept at the ST 14 packaging line, congesting the work area and movement path.
cases.action: Remove excess packaging material from the line and keep only the quantity required for the shift.

cases.obs: Operator repeatedly found standing on the machine platform of the packaging line while the line was running, despite earlier warnings.
cases.action: Instruct all operators not to stand on the machine platform while the line is running and enforce through shift supervision.

cases.obs: Coils stored on the floor in front of the spooler area room door, completely blocking access and emergency egress.
cases.action: Remove the coils from the doorway, mark the door approach as a no-storage zone and keep it clear at all times.

cases.obs: A slit coil was placed on the walkway in the ST2 finish coil area, obstructing safe pedestrian movement.
cases.action: Shift the coil to the designated coil storage area and keep the walkway clear.

cases.obs: Excessive vegetation growth and poor housekeeping behind the SVC (static VAR compensator) area.
cases.action: Remove the vegetation, carry out housekeeping behind the SVC and add the area to the routine cleaning schedule.

cases.obs: Oil spilled on the floor near the SGL-1 fume exhaust blower, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean the oil from the floor near the blower and identify and arrest the source of leakage.

cases.obs: Unused metal structure left on the ST1 line, creating an obstruction and trip hazard.
cases.action: Remove the unused metal structure from the line and send it to the designated scrap area.

cases.obs: Spare belt left lying on top of a motor behind the SGL-1 line, where it could be drawn into moving parts.
cases.action: Remove the belt from the motor and store spares at the designated place.

cases.obs: Damaged wire ropes found lying below rolls in the old roll shop, with a risk of being reused for lifting.
cases.action: Discard the damaged wire ropes (cut to prevent reuse) and keep only inspected, certified tackles in service.

cases.obs: Motors left lying around the Wider ST Lines-1 area instead of at a designated storage place.
cases.action: Clean the area and shift the motors to the designated storage place.

cases.obs: Electrical motor left lying at the SGL-1 top heads area instead of its designated storage place.
cases.action: Shift the motor to the designated storage place and keep spares out of the line area.

cases.obs: Water bottle left on the electrical control post in the Steckel mill walkway gallery.
cases.action: Remove the bottle and instruct staff not to keep liquids or personal items on electrical control posts.

cases.obs: Oil barrel left unattended in the roughing mill descaling area instead of the designated storage place.
cases.action: Shift the oil barrel to the designated oil storage area.

cases.obs: Oily cloths and waste lying on the floor behind the SGL-1 top heads, adding combustible load.
cases.action: Remove the oily cloths and waste into a closed oily-waste bin.

cases.obs: Employee found working in the Wider ST Lines-1 area without a safety helmet.
cases.action: Stop the employee, ensure the helmet is worn and re-brief the team on mandatory PPE requirements.

cases.obs: Scrap material left lying on the tool changer in the SPD-2 spooler area.
cases.action: Remove the scrap from the tool changer into the scrap bin and keep machine surfaces clear.

cases.obs: A damaged measuring tape was being used on the spooler line.
cases.action: Withdraw and discard the damaged tape and issue a serviceable one.

cases.obs: Scrap bin in the Cu-Ni CRM bell annealing area overfilled beyond capacity, with material protruding and falling outside the bin.
cases.action: Remove the excess scrap, arrange timely disposal and replace the bin before it reaches its safe capacity.

cases.obs: Loose steel sheets with exposed sharp edges stacked in the material-handling pathway near stored coils in the slitting area.
cases.action: Shift all end-cut pieces to the melting yard and keep the material-handling pathway clear.

cases.obs: Coil placed in the walkway at the CRM milling and rewinding area, obstructing pedestrian movement.
cases.action: Remove the coil from the walkway to the designated storage location and keep walkways clear.

cases.obs: Open hose pipe left lying on the floor near the Sundwig mill, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Remove the hose after use and store it on a hook or reel.

cases.obs: Heavy water and sludge deposits behind the AP-2 pickling pumps, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean the rinse-water circulation area, include it in daily housekeeping and arrest any source of leakage.

cases.obs: Hose pipe stored inside the VCB room near the old 20-Hi mill.
cases.action: Remove the hose from the VCB/ECR room and keep electrical rooms free of unrelated material.

cases.obs: Contract worker found pushing the coil wrap by hand without wearing hand gloves at the ST5 line.

cases.obs: Waste material found in the cooling tower 1 drain pit at the HRD power plant.

cases.obs: Coil strip scrap lying on the pathway between Sherman mills 3 and 4, creating a trip and cut hazard.

cases.obs: Workers at the CRD-4 project civil site found wearing damaged hand gloves.
cases.action: Replace the damaged gloves immediately and include glove condition in the daily PPE check.

cases.obs: Loose electrical wires and a removed panel cover left lying at the HBA3 and AP3 exit section.

cases.obs: Unused roll left lying on the floor in the AP3 quench area.

cases.obs: Unused paint material left lying in the CRD power plant area instead of being stored properly.

cases.obs: Heavy dust accumulation on the bridge platform of EOT crane 06 at the ST2 line.

cases.obs: Motor left lying on the walkway near the degreasing line uncoiler, obstructing safe access.

cases.obs: Large quantity of rope lying on the walkway below the degreasing area at the VBA exit looper.

cases.obs: Door at the ST4 line not closed properly, swinging into and blocking the walkway.

cases.obs: Unused electrical panel left in the AP2 pickling section.

cases.obs: Old used primary filters left lying beside the CRD power plant area.

cases.obs: Waste interleaving paper (ILP) lying on the walkways of the ST-1 slitting line.

cases.obs: Discarded hand grinder left between pillars in the CP1 ECR area.

cases.obs: Stainless steel scrap pieces scattered below the CP2 trimmer area, creating cut and trip hazards.

cases.obs: Slit transfer trolley parked in front of an electrical panel in the no-bag slitting area, blocking access.

cases.obs: Waste materials stored around the SMS-2 pump house, indicating poor housekeeping.

cases.obs: Waste materials scattered along the forging-side plant road, creating an obstruction.
cases.action: Remove the waste materials and carry out housekeeping along the roadside.

cases.obs: Water accumulated around the cooling tower at the air compressor house due to a leakage.

cases.obs: Material bags torn at CBL press 6, scattering blanks on the shop floor.

cases.action: Provide a suitable respirator to the painter and ensure it is worn throughout painting work.

cases.obs: Scrap bundles placed in front of the gate entry of the no-bag slitting area, obstructing access.

cases.obs: Loose scrap placed on the ECR walkway in the no-bag slitting area.

cases.obs: Electrical control panel at the CP2 recoiler end in very poor condition, needing deep cleaning.

cases.obs: Drip trays of the oil tanks at the 220 TPD oxygen plant very dirty with oil residue.

cases.obs: Red pit safety warning light in the old roll shop is not working.

cases.obs: Water on the walkway near the Z5 mill exit gate, creating a slip hazard.

cases.obs: Oil leaking from the DTR expand/collapse rotary union at the Z5 mill onto the walking area.

cases.obs: Electrical panel lock found open in the boiler room.

cases.obs: Fan box at 4-Hi Mill-2 found open.

cases.obs: Coil MS sleeve placed on the rail track of the leader end stand trolley at the AP4 entry section.

cases.obs: ILP pieces scattered near the DTR side of the Frohling mill, creating a trip hazard.

cases.obs: Electrical socket board and its wiring in the pickling mechanical yard were left open and unsafe.

cases.obs: Pipelines in the HFO separator room have no colour coding or flow direction marking.

cases.obs: Oil leakage observed from the Bridle-2 gearbox at PTF-2.

cases.obs: Oil leaking from the steering roll cylinder at PTF-1.

cases.obs: Motor placed on the walkway in the CP-3 & LPL main ECR.

cases.obs: Water leaking from the degreasing drain pipeline onto the AP4 entry walkway, making it slippery.

cases.obs: Plant pots placed on the walkway behind the RO plant, narrowing the passage and creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Shift the plant pots to a designated place off the walkway and keep the walkway clear.

cases.obs: Damaged wire rope left lying on the floor in the Steckel mill slab storage area, where it could be reused.
cases.action: Discard the damaged wire rope (cut and send for melting) and quarantine any damaged lifting tackle.

cases.obs: Outside truck parked in front of a fire hydrant, blocking immediate access to it during an emergency.
cases.action: Remove the truck, mark a no-parking zone around the hydrant and enforce it through security patrols.

cases.obs: Pressure gauge on the LPG cylinder regulator in the SAF-1 pump house found damaged.
cases.action: Replace the damaged regulator/pressure gauge and leak-test the connections.

cases.obs: Fire buckets at CBL Press-1 found empty of sand.
cases.action: Fill the fire buckets with dry sand and include them in the monthly fire equipment inspection.

cases.obs: Electrical junction box at the Steckel mill entry hot coiler furnace not covered properly.
cases.action: Close and secure the JB cover properly.

cases.obs: Pedestrian walkway directly adjacent to the road in the slitting coil loading/unloading area is not barricaded from vehicle traffic.
cases.action: Install a railing/barricade between the walkway and the road.

cases.obs: Pedestrian walkway in the slitting coil loading/unloading area obstructed by scrap bins.
cases.action: Remove the scrap bins from the walkway and place them in a designated area.

cases.obs: Water leaking from the pump in the SMS-2 pump house, causing water accumulation on the floor.
cases.action: Arrest the pump leakage (replace gland/seal as required) and clean and dry the area.

cases.obs: Barricading at the CCS-2 bloom storage area found damaged or removed.
cases.action: Restore proper barricading around the bloom storage area.

cases.obs: Damaged and deteriorated insulating rubber mat in front of the electrical panel in the SMS-2 pump house MCC/PCC/VCB room.
cases.action: Replace the mat with a new insulating rubber mat of the correct voltage grade.

cases.obs: Insulating rubber mat missing behind the electrical panel in the SMS-2 pump house MCC/PCC/VCB room.
cases.action: Provide an insulating rubber mat at the back side of the electrical panel.

cases.obs: Barricading around the base of the high-tension pole near the carpenter shop found damaged, allowing unauthorized access.
cases.action: Repair or replace the fencing/barricade around the HT pole base.

cases.obs: Assembly point board behind the Bell Annealing park is hidden by tree branches, reducing its visibility.
cases.action: Trim the tree branches so the assembly point board is clearly visible.

cases.obs: At the CCS-1 bloom loading point a loose SS sheet is used as a barricade instead of a hard barricade plate, and it can get caught on vehicle bodies.
cases.action: Install a fixed hard barricade plate at the bloom loading point.

cases.obs: Safety railing gate at the Z1 mill POR coil car found damaged.
cases.action: Repair the railing gate and instruct crane operators on safe load movement to prevent further damage.

cases.obs: Low illumination at the base fan motor assembly in the Bell Annealing cellar.
cases.action: Install additional LED lighting (e.g. 80 W fitting) to achieve the required lux level.

cases.obs: Railing on the upper-right side of the strip mill scrap cutting platform is incomplete and the toe board is missing, creating fall and falling-object hazards.
cases.action: Complete the railing (top and mid rail) and fit a toe board along the platform edge; barricade the area until the work is done.

cases.obs: Door handle of the ECR panel in the New Roll Shop found damaged.
cases.action: Repair or replace the panel door handle so the door can be closed and locked.

cases.obs: Water accumulated on the New Roll Shop floor near the roll cooling stand, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean the area and rectify the cause of water accumulation (leakage or drainage).

cases.obs: Material stored above the barricade height at an elevated location near Melting Furnace-3, creating a falling-object risk to people below.
cases.action: Remove or reposition the material below the barricade/edge protection height and provide toe boards where needed.

cases.obs: Oil accumulated on the floor around the CNC machine in the Old Roll Shop due to manual lubrication, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean the oil immediately, use a drip tray during lubrication and clean the area after each lubrication job.

cases.obs: Roll shifting trolley parked on the walkway in the Z-mill roll grinding shop, obstructing the passage.
cases.action: Park the trolley in its designated, marked area away from the walkway.

cases.obs: Walkway near the AP4 mechanical maintenance area obstructed by coil sleeves and a parked vehicle.
cases.action: Remove the coil sleeves and vehicle and keep the walkway clear for emergency access.

cases.obs: Side railing missing on the Main Store emergency exit platform, creating a fall-from-height hazard.
cases.action: Install standard side railing (top rail, mid rail and toe board) on the emergency exit platform.

cases.obs: Numerous improperly routed and poorly insulated wires found in the new operator cabin of the Steckel mill pump house.
cases.action: Insulate or replace damaged wires, remove redundant wiring and dress cables in covered trays.

cases.obs: Rotating parts of the SAF-1 ID fan found without proper guarding, creating an entanglement hazard.
cases.action: Install a fixed guard covering all exposed rotating parts of the ID fan and do not run it without guards.

cases.obs: LPG cylinder left near the heat of the running strip in the strip mill extractor power pack area, risking cylinder failure and fire.
cases.action: Remove the LPG cylinder immediately and store cylinders upright and secured in a designated area away from heat sources.

cases.obs: Coupling guard missing on a running pump in the roughing mill 2Hi and motor bush pump area.
cases.action: Fit a fixed coupling guard on the pump before running and include guard checks in routine inspection.

cases.obs: Many chemical cans and containers lying scattered on the floor of the SMS-1 new pump house, creating trip and chemical spill hazards.
cases.action: Remove empty or unneeded containers and store chemicals in a designated, labelled area with secondary containment.

cases.obs: Non-standard access ladder at the SAF-1 bag house is not secured, has improper dimensions and rests on accumulated dust, making it unstable.
cases.action: Replace it with a standard fixed ladder or approved access platform secured at top and bottom.

cases.obs: Non-standard access ladder at Molasses Tank-2 has excessive rung spacing and an improper climbing angle, preventing safe three-point contact.
cases.action: Replace or modify the ladder to standard (uniform rung spacing, correct inclination, handholds) or provide a stair.

cases.obs: No barricading or guard rail around the SAF-2 ladle/tapping area, allowing people to enter the molten metal splash zone.
cases.action: Install robust guard rails around the tapping area, leaving only the operational opening for the metal pan/slag pot, controlled by a removable chain and floor marking.

cases.obs: Unguarded opening next to the rainwater collection tank at the staff colony sewage pit pump house; a person could step into the pit.
cases.action: Cover the opening with a secured plate or grating, or provide a guardrail around it.

cases.obs: Upper panel in the SPD-3 main office is mounted too high to be operated safely from floor level.
cases.action: Fabricate and install a fixed platform with handrail to reach the upper panel.

cases.obs: Electrical panel at the PTF-10 exit section is mounted next to the hydrant water line, risking water ingress and electrocution.
cases.action: Provide a partition/barrier between the hydrant line and the panel, or relocate the panel.

cases.obs: In-house heater in the SPD-3 AHU chiller area running hot with its cable touching the heater body, flammable sheets close by, and no barricading or warning signs.
cases.action: Reroute the cable away from the heater body, remove flammable material, barricade the heater and display hot-surface/danger signs.

cases.obs: Machine guards loose at several places on the PTF-9 furnace line, with mounting bolts missing.
cases.action: Refit all guards firmly with the full set of mounting bolts and check guard fixings during routine inspection.

cases.obs: Motor coupling guard on the degreasing line is loose and not firmly fixed.
cases.action: Bolt the coupling guard firmly in place and check it during routine inspection.

cases.obs: Water dripping onto the insulating mat at the BA-1 electrical panel area.
cases.action: Arrest the water leakage above the panel area and dry or replace the insulating mat.

cases.obs: Guard on the ST-1 slitting line is striking against a rotating part.
cases.action: Realign and fix the guard firmly so that it clears the rotating part.

cases.obs: Fire detection panel in the Old 20 Hi mill ECR has no power supply, leaving the area without fire detection.
cases.action: Restore the power supply to the fire detection panel, ensure battery backup and test the system.

cases.obs: Fume exhaust of the RM-1 mill was switched off while the mill was running.
cases.action: Interlock the fume exhaust blower with mill operation so the mill cannot run without exhaust.

cases.hazard: gaps and dust on deck platform
cases.obs: Gaps in the deck platform of the AP2 shot blasting area, with heavy shot blasting dust accumulation, creating slip, trip and fall-through hazards.
cases.action: Clean the shot blasting dust from the platform and cover all gaps with secured plates or grating.

cases.obs: Damaged railing on the AP2 shot blasting area platform, creating a fall-from-height hazard.
cases.action: Repair or replace the railing to standard (top rail, mid rail, toe board) and barricade the edge until repaired.

cases.obs: Guards missing on the chain and sprocket drive in the AP2 shot blasting area.
cases.action: Install fixed guards on the chain-sprocket drive before the equipment is operated.

cases.obs: Damaged fan switch at the walking beam furnace charging side, posing electric shock and fire risk.
cases.action: Replace the damaged switch board with a new one.

cases.obs: Cables lying scattered on the floor at the Z5 mill, exposing them to damage and creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Route the cables through the designated cable tray and dress them properly.

cases.obs: No clearly defined safe access or emergency exit for persons working inside the plate annealing furnace during shutdown.
cases.action: Open additional furnace side gates as emergency exits, keep access clear and arrange a standby attendant and rescue plan.

cases.obs: Deep excavation behind the propane yard without hard barricading or warning signs, with excavated soil and material placed close to the edge.
cases.action: Provide hard barricading and warning signs around the excavation, keep spoil and material well back from the edge, and cover the pit when not in use.

cases.obs: Slippery floor at the HBA3 exit section due to oil leakage.
cases.action: Arrest the oil leakage at source and clean the floor.

cases.obs: Safe working pressure range not marked on the pressure gauge at the HBA3 exit section.
cases.action: Mark the safe operating range (green zone) and maximum limit on the gauge dial.

cases.obs: Pressure gauge on the band saw machine in the machine shop has no visible calibration sticker and no safe operating range marking.
cases.action: Calibrate the gauge through an authorized agency, affix a calibration sticker with due date, and mark the permissible operating range (green zone).

cases.obs: Many thinner and chemical bottles stored in the SMF first-floor office without labels and without MSDS available.
cases.action: Move the chemicals to a designated chemical store, label every container, keep MSDS at the point of use and provide spill trays.

cases.obs: Rejected belt lying on the SAF-2 furnace tapping platform, creating a trip hazard near the molten metal zone.
cases.action: Remove the belt and other unwanted items and keep the tapping platform clear.

cases.obs: Pieces of MS strap lying on the floor near the DTR at the Z5 mill, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Remove the MS strap pieces and dispose of them in the scrap bin.

cases.obs: ETR side platform at the Z-2 mill, used every shift for sample checking, is unstable and unsafe, with oil present on it.
cases.action: Stop using the platform, weld and secure it so it is stable, and clean and contain the oil.

cases.obs: Electrical cable at ETP-1 routed along a leaking, rusted pipeline support and tied with cloth.
cases.action: Lay the cable in a separate, properly supported cable tray away from the pipeline.

cases.obs: Heavy smoke from the slab annealing furnace spreading into the Bell Annealing shed, reducing crane operator visibility and causing miscommunication with floor staff.
cases.action: Restore proper chimney draft/exhaust so furnace smoke is extracted and does not enter the shed; stop crane movement when visibility is poor.

cases.obs: Top landing of the ETP-1 staircase obstructed by stacked items such as filter plates.
cases.action: Remove the stacked items and keep the staircase landing clear for safe movement.

cases.obs: Electrical cable at ETP-1 routed along the staircase railing support, so the railing could become live if the cable is damaged.
cases.action: Reroute the cable through a separate cable tray away from the railing.

cases.hazard: scrap rails lying in looper area
no barricade at crane stair platform

cases.obs: Paper rolls and sleeves stored behind the electrical panel in the SPD-2 spooler area, creating a fire risk.
cases.action: Remove the combustible material immediately, keep the area behind panels clear and mark it as a no-storage zone.

cases.obs: Sides of the conveyor belt at the Ball Mill primary crusher are not guarded against contact with moving parts, and no warning signs are provided.
cases.action: Install fixed side guards/railing along the conveyor and provide warning signs near the moving parts.

cases.obs: Coils stored close to the vehicle path in the Steckel mill coil yard without proper support, risking rolling or being struck by vehicles.
cases.action: Store coils in designated coil trays/cradles away from the vehicle movement path.

cases.obs: Rotating parts of the conveyor in the Briquette Plant stacker area found without guarding.
cases.action: Install fixed guards on all exposed rotating parts (pulleys, rollers and drives) of the conveyor.

cases.hazard: sheets in lifting area, bad barricade

cases.obs: Water leaking from the cooling water manifold on the SAF-2 furnace floor.
cases.action: Arrest the manifold leakage and keep the furnace floor dry.

cases.hazard: discarded seat left in work area

cases.obs: Drain pit cover plate on the reheating furnace charging side not installed properly, leaving a trip and fall-in hazard.
cases.action: Install and secure the drain pit cover plate properly so it cannot be displaced.

cases.obs: Water leaking from the pump gland in the CCS-1 pump house, causing water accumulation on the floor.
cases.action: Rectify the gland leakage (adjust or replace packing) and provide a gland drain pipe to the drain.

cases.obs: Lights in the Steckel mill auxiliary transformer room not working.
cases.action: Replace the faulty light fittings with standard fittings and restore illumination.

cases.obs: Trolleys placed in the walkway and in front of the emergency exit door in the CCP roll grinder area.
cases.action: Remove the trolleys, keep the walkway and emergency exit clear, and mark keep-clear zones.

cases.obs: No ladder or safe access provided to reach the AP2 pulsating valves located above the shot blasting machine.
cases.action: Provide a fixed caged ladder or an access platform with railing to reach the pulsating valves.

cases.obs: Electrical panel at CRD-4 Rolling Mill 1 is not provided with double earthing.
cases.action: Provide two separate earth connections to the panel body and test the earth resistance.

cases.hazard: railing without top and mid rail

cases.obs: Safety belt with expired third-party inspection (TPI) found at the CRD-4 Rolling Mill 1 project site.
cases.action: Withdraw and scrap safety belts with expired TPI and keep only inspected, tagged fall-arrest equipment on site.

cases.obs: Uneven floor near the AP3 entry coiler area by the entry pulpit, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Repair the trench area floor to a level, even surface.

cases.hazard: no warning light at under-furnace stairs

cases.obs: Ladder at NCH2 in the Bell Annealing coil storage area is bent, poorly supported and misaligned, and could shift or collapse during use.
cases.action: Remove the damaged ladder from use and replace it with a sound, properly secured ladder.

cases.hazard: railing removed at hot bloom area
cases.obs: Safety railing at the CCS-2 bloom stacking area removed and not reinstated, exposing people to falls and contact with hot blooms.
cases.action: Reinstate the safety railing, barricade the hot bloom stacking area and restrict access until the railing is secured.

cases.hazard: crane motor lying in dispatch area

cases.obs: ETR side platform at the Z-2 mill, used every shift for gauge sample checking, is unstable and has oil on it, creating fall and slip hazards.
cases.action: Repair and secure the platform and provide an anti-slip surface (e.g. tack-weld beads or chequered plate) on the platform plate.

cases.obs: Damaged pipe hanging in an unsafe condition near the strip mill reheating furnace, creating a falling-object hazard.
cases.action: Barricade the area below the pipe, then safely remove or support the pipe using proper rigging under supervision.

cases.obs: Castor wheel locking arrangement on the mobile scaffold at Down Coiler-2 is non-functional.
cases.action: Withdraw the scaffold from use and repair or replace the castor brakes so all wheels lock before use.

cases.obs: Cut-off portion of a structural pillar protruding above floor level at the Ara machine in the wooden pallet stock yard, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Cut the protruding portion flush with the floor and level the surface.

cases.obs: Water accumulated on the floor in front of the JB at Bundle Press-1, creating electrical and slip hazards.
cases.action: Remove the water, find and stop its source, and keep the area in front of the JB dry.

cases.obs: Bare spare wire lying near the AP4 pickling SMB-2 panel.
cases.action: Remove the redundant wire, or terminate and dress it properly.

cases.obs: Drain covers missing or not properly installed at several locations in the CCS-1 pump house, leaving openings that can trap feet.
cases.action: Provide load-bearing drain covers at all locations and fit them level and securely.

cases.obs: Scrap material scattered on the vehicle road in the SS scrap yard, with scrap piles kept close to the road edge.
cases.action: Shift the scrap to designated stacking areas, keep the road clear and maintain safe clearance between piles and the road.

cases.obs: Trench cover at the entrance of the SMS-2 covered walkway is damaged.
cases.action: Replace the damaged trench cover with a load-rated cover fitted flush with the floor.

cases.obs: A piece of SS sheet kept along the walkway in the CTL piler area, which could cut people passing by.
cases.action: Remove the sheet to its designated storage place and keep walkways free of sharp material.

cases.obs: Water filling point and hose at the strip mill coil cooling tank area obstruct the walkway.
cases.action: Relocate the water filling point and hose away from the walkway.

cases.obs: Emergency exit of the CBL transformer VCB room obstructed by unnecessary materials.
cases.action: Remove the materials and keep the emergency exit clear and accessible at all times.

cases.obs: Earthing strip raised above the walkway surface at the OHC, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Reroute the earthing strip below or along the edge of the walkway, or cover it with a ramped protective cover.

cases.obs: Portable ladder at Security Gate No. 2 is damaged at the base and wheel connection.
cases.action: Withdraw the damaged ladder from use immediately and replace it with a sound ladder.

cases.obs: Water leaking from the AC unit at Security Gate No. 2, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Repair the AC drain/leakage and clean and dry the affected area.

cases.hazard: pipeline at head height over stair

cases.obs: Acid pipeline leaking in the AP2 acid storage area.
cases.action: Isolate the line, arrest the leakage, neutralise and clean up the spilled acid, and barricade the area until repaired.

cases.obs: Coil placed in the walkway near the AP4 seam welder section.
cases.action: Remove the coil from the walkway and instruct crane operators never to place coils on walkways.

cases.obs: Top cover of seal roll #4 in the AP4 pickling section found open.
cases.action: Refit the seal roll top cover and instruct the pickling team not to remove it during operation.

cases.hazard: sheet rolls stacked at loading point
brake guard removed and left on floor
open pit in front of ecr

cases.obs: Electrical panel near column C-9 in the AP4 pickling section covered with polythene, a combustible material.
cases.action: Remove the polythene; if protection is needed, use a fire-retardant cover that does not block panel ventilation.

cases.obs: Oil leaking from the hydraulic power pack at CCP Casting Line-2.
cases.action: Rectify the leaking joint or seal of the power pack and clean up the spilled oil.

cases.obs: AP3 line spares stored at the HBA-3 POR-1 side obstruct access to the valve stands in the JSB area, restricting emergency and operational access.
cases.action: Remove the spares to a designated store and keep access to the valve stands clear and marked.

cases.obs: Handle of the brick cutter machine at the AOD relining trolley is too short, exposing the operator to injury.
cases.action: Extend the cutter machine handle so the operator's hands stay at a safe distance from the cutter.

cases.obs: No heat shield on the railing near the ladle preheating burner at the AOD relining trolley, exposing workers to radiant heat.
cases.action: Fit a heat-shield sheet on the railing to block direct exposure to the preheating burner.

cases.obs: Trench cover missing near the laminar cooling hot well pump in the strip mill coil cooling tank area.
cases.action: Clean the scale from the trench and refit a secured trench cover.

cases.obs: Path to the eye shower at Barrel Polish 3-6 obstructed by hoppers.
cases.action: Clear the path and mark a keep-clear zone so the eye shower is always reachable.

cases.obs: Loose guard on the RGM near the CRD-2 SPM lines.
cases.action: Refit the guard with proper angle supports and secure it with bolts.

cases.obs: No barricading near the rotating paper winder at the SGL-2 bottom heads, allowing people to approach the rotating part.
cases.action: Install a fixed railing/guard around the paper winder to prevent access to the rotating part.

cases.hazard: drinking water point at running line

cases.obs: Water gushing from the AP3 quench section outlet and accumulating in the coil stand area.
cases.action: Inspect and rectify the quench outlet to control the discharge and keep the coil stand area dry.

cases.obs: Earthing connection of the L.T. PHE-01 charge air cooling water motor has no identification marking.
cases.action: Identify the earthing connection with green colour coding or ferrule and verify the earthing arrangement.

cases.obs: One step missing on the stair at the AP3 entry looper drive side.
cases.action: Fabricate and fix the missing stair step.

cases.obs: Toe guards missing on the P5 line bridle platform, creating a falling-object hazard.
cases.action: Fit toe guards along the edges of the bridle platform.

cases.obs: No siren/warning light provided at the SPM hydraulic cellar.
cases.action: Install a siren/beacon light at the cellar and test it periodically.

cases.obs: Damaged staircase step at the SAF-1 second-floor main power pack.
cases.action: Weld or replace the damaged step plate.

cases.hazard: press guard gate open in operation

cases.obs: Fire hose box in the Z3 mill completely obstructed by an equipment cart and stacked materials, preventing quick access in a fire.
cases.action: Remove the cart and materials and keep a marked keep-clear zone in front of the fire hose box.

cases.obs: Fume extraction pipeline of NEL tank #2 in the AP4 pickling section is broken, releasing fumes into the work area.
cases.action: Repair the fume pipeline and check the extraction system for proper suction.

cases.obs: No barricading at the edge of the excavation at the CRD-4 project site.
cases.action: Provide hard barricading with warning signs along the excavation edge.

cases.obs: Small coil rolls placed on the walkway at the entry/exit of Slitter Line-1, blocking the passage and emergency exit.
cases.action: Remove the rolls and keep the entry/exit walkway clear for emergency egress.

cases.hazard: no fall protection at pit edge

cases.obs: Barricade railing gate at Slitter Line-1 left open while the line was running, allowing access to rotating parts.
cases.action: Keep the gate closed during operation and fit an interlock or self-closing latch on the gate.

cases.obs: Air hose lying across the walkway at CCP Casting Line-1, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Reroute and secure the air hose off the walkway, overhead or along the edge with a cover.

cases.obs: Trench cover not properly fixed between the HBA-1 and HBA-2 lines in front of the HBA-1 coil car exit.
cases.action: Refit and secure the trench cover plate so it sits flush and cannot shift.

cases.obs: Water spillage near the roadside at the Wartsila power plant front road, creating a slip hazard and algae growth.
cases.action: Identify and repair the leak source, clear the standing water and clean the path.

cases.obs: First-aid box at the MS scrap yard container loading area is poorly maintained, with damaged dressings, water inside and no inventory record.
cases.action: Replace the contents, keep the box dry and sealed, and maintain a checked inventory record.

cases.hazard: open cable pit in mcc room
water logging and loose drain cover

cases.obs: No emergency lighting near Spooler recoiler No. 12 in SPD-2, leaving the area dark during a power failure.
cases.action: Install an emergency light near Spooler No. 12 and test it periodically.

cases.obs: Opening in the ETP-1 tank cover left uncovered, creating a risk of a person falling into the tank.
cases.action: Close the opening with a secured plate and bars and keep the tank cover intact.

cases.obs: Loose wheel and tyre lying on the MHME workshop floor, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Isolate the area, remove the wheel and tyre from the floor to its storage place and restore housekeeping.

cases.hazard: oil bucket in power pack room

cases.obs: Supply cable of a wall-mounted fan lying on the floor at the reheating furnace discharging side.
cases.action: Provide a proper cable and fixed switch for the fan and dress the cable off the floor.

cases.obs: Electrical panel at the SS scrap yard baling press area found damaged, creating a risk of electric shock, short circuit and fire.
cases.action: Isolate and replace the damaged panel, inspect and test the wiring, display warning signage and verify safe operation before re-energising.

cases.hazard: safety harness not anchored at height

cases.obs: Oil accumulated in the 2-Hi oil cellar at the roughing mill due to leakage.
cases.action: Arrest the oil leakage and clean the accumulated oil from the cellar.

cases.obs: Trucks parked outside SMS-1 near the slag yard are secured with only a single wheel stopper.
cases.action: Provide double wheel stoppers (chocks) for parked trucks and ensure both are used.

cases.obs: At the SPD-3 packing line, the stacker upper limit switch lever is missing, so the stacker travels to full height and strikes the mechanical stopper, risking falling material.
cases.action: Repair or replace the upper limit switch lever, test that the stacker stops before the mechanical stopper, and fit a top stopper on the trolley.

cases.obs: Junction box cover missing on the coil transfer trolley at the Z4 mill roll grinding shop.
cases.action: Provide and fix a cover on the coil transfer trolley junction box.

cases.obs: Coupling shaft guard of AP4 pickling exhaust blower-3 not fitted properly.
cases.action: Refit and secure the coupling shaft guard correctly over the coupling.

cases.obs: At the SPD-3 packing line, all stack conveyor chains are exposed without guards, allowing contact with moving parts.
cases.action: Install suitable fixed guards on all exposed stack conveyor chains.

cases.obs: Inspection due dates of most earthing pits in the oxygen plant air compressor area have expired.
cases.action: Test all earthing pits, record results and update the inspection due dates.

cases.obs: Protruding pipe stub above floor level in front of PTF-7 cooling blower-3, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Cut the pipe stub flush with the floor.

cases.obs: Loose wiring and an extension board lying in the open at the reheating furnace dummy stacking area.
cases.action: Provide a fixed, wall-mounted switch board for the fan and dress the wiring.

cases.obs: Unused foundation bolt protruding on the walkway at the coil cooling tank area, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Cut the unused foundation bolt flush with the floor and clean the area.

cases.obs: Drainage water tank at SMS-2 pump house corroded and leaking, with water accumulated on the floor.
cases.action: Replace the corroded drainage tank and clean the accumulated water from the floor.

cases.obs: Roadside LED light at the briquette plant maintenance area found non-functional.
cases.action: Repair or replace the LED light and confirm it is working.

cases.obs: Neutral electrolyte (NEL) leaking from the NEL tank-2 fume pipeline and accumulating on the electrode at the AP4 pickling section.
cases.action: Repair the NEL tank-2 fume pipeline leak and clean the accumulated electrolyte from the electrode.

cases.obs: Steam leaking from a valve joint near the DM water plant gate at AP4 utility.
cases.action: Isolate the steam line and arrest the leak at the valve joint.

cases.obs: Pipeline running across the walkway at the reheating furnace charging side, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Provide a crossover platform or cover over the pipeline on the walkway.

cases.obs: Cable trench cover missing near the electrical panel at the reheating furnace charging side.
cases.action: Provide and fix covers on the open cable trench.

cases.obs: Cable trench cover sheet found open at the SAF-1 ground floor road area.
cases.action: Close the cable cover sheet and secure it with bolts.

cases.obs: Guard over a rotating part at the A1 line annealing section has a missing joint bolt and other bolts loose.
cases.action: Replace the missing bolt, tighten all loose guard fasteners and verify the guard is secure.

cases.obs: Rotating wheel of the P5 line uncoiler found without proper guarding at the coil unloading gate entry.
cases.action: Provide a fixed guard over the uncoiler rotating wheel before further operation.

cases.obs: Continuous water dripping from pipelines above an electrical panel near the P5 Denox area, creating risk of short circuit, electrocution and slips.
cases.action: Arrest the pipeline leakage (clamp or repair the joint) and keep the panel area dry.

cases.obs: Biometric access control at the bell annealing ECR is not working, allowing unauthorised direct entry into the electrical room.
cases.action: Repair the biometric access system and prohibit entry to the ECR without authorisation.

cases.obs: Used hand gloves stacked on top of electrical panels at the BF mill, creating a fire and electrical hazard.
cases.action: Remove all combustible material from the panels and keep used PPE at the designated place.

cases.hazard: welding rods and debris on floor

cases.obs: Illumination at the SAF-1 metal pan working area is inadequate, increasing the risk of slips, trips and operational errors.
cases.action: Repair or replace non-functional lights with LED fittings and verify adequate lux level.

cases.obs: MCB box cover left open at the SAF-1 furnace tapping area, exposing electrical parts.
cases.action: Close and secure the MCB box cover.

cases.obs: Emergency exit staircase from the PAF ECR first floor removed during cooling tower relocation, leaving no emergency escape route or safe access to the cooling tower.
cases.action: Reinstate a permanent staircase at the ECR first-floor emergency exit and keep the emergency route clear.

cases.hazard: stand and pallets left near base

cases.obs: Trench cover displaced from its position beside the FAFS main road, creating a trip and fall hazard.
cases.action: Reposition and level the trench cover and secure it in place.

cases.obs: Water drainage hose placed in front of the fire extinguisher at Induction Furnace-3.
cases.action: Remove the hose from the extinguisher access and provide a separate storage place for it.

cases.obs: Floor along the slab transfer trolley rail track damaged in the Bell Annealing shed, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Repair the damaged floor along the rail track to restore a level walking surface.

cases.obs: Steel coils stored on both sides of the CP lines pedestrian walkway with no clearance from the demarcation line; coils could roll or tip onto the walkway.
cases.action: Shift coils to designated storage areas clear of the walkway, chock stored coils against rolling and instruct shift in-charges not to place coils near walkways.

cases.obs: Guard on a rotating part at slitting line ST-1 found tilted and able to contact the rotating part.
cases.action: Realign the guard and fix it firmly so it stays clear of the rotating part.

cases.obs: No guard provided on the motor coupling at BA-1.
cases.action: Provide and fix a coupling guard that fully covers the rotating coupling.

cases.obs: Mounting bolts of the guard mesh over rotating parts found removed on the Cu-Ni pickling line, leaving the guard unsecured.
cases.action: Refit and tighten all guard mesh bolts so the guard is secure and stable.

cases.obs: Coils kept on the walkway in the CP lines coil storage area.
cases.action: Shift the coils to their designated area, clear the walkways and instruct shift teams not to place coils near walkways.

cases.obs: Trench cover at Casting Line-1 not placed properly, leaving a gap at the side.
cases.action: Refit the trench cover properly so that no gap remains.

cases.obs: Power (drive) wheel of the crane cross-travel trolley found damaged and worn during inspection.
cases.action: Replace the damaged cross-travel trolley power wheel and check alignment before returning the crane to service.

cases.obs: Wheel of a wheeled fire extinguisher at the HRD fire hydrant point found detached and out of position.
cases.action: Refit or replace the extinguisher wheel so the unit can be moved readily in an emergency.

cases.obs: Fire extinguisher discharge nozzle found damaged at the Strip Mill fire point.
cases.action: Replace the damaged nozzle (or the extinguisher) and confirm the unit is ready for use.

cases.obs: Electrical junction box at the pusher valve stand exposed to rainwater ingress on the reheating furnace charging side.
cases.action: Provide a protective sheet cover over the junction box to prevent water ingress.

cases.obs: SGL-1 line operated with grinder head door 2 open, allowing grinding fumes to escape into the workplace.
cases.action: Run the line only with grinder head doors closed and improve the efficiency of the fume extraction system.

cases.obs: Waste cloths and other items kept under the running strip at HBA-1 entry; people reaching for them could contact the sharp moving strip.
cases.action: Remove stored items, provide a railing/barricade with signage to prevent access under the running line, and brief the team.

cases.obs: Project work at the CBL project carried out beside the road without barricading.
cases.action: Provide proper barricading between the work area and the road.

cases.obs: Covers of all alkali and intermediate tanks at HBA-1 entry left open with unrestricted access; a person falling in could be fatally injured.
cases.action: Close and secure all tank covers and restrict access to the tank tops to authorised persons.

cases.obs: No proper access ladder on the scaffold at the CBL project; a worker climbed up the scaffold structural members.
cases.action: Provide a proper access ladder or stair on the scaffold and prohibit climbing on scaffold members.

cases.obs: Leaking valve in the Nobag robot area temporarily patched with M-Seal epoxy instead of being properly repaired.
cases.action: Replace the valve with a new one, or repair it properly, at the earliest maintenance opportunity.

cases.obs: Stair handrail found damaged at the ladle heating area (BC row).
cases.action: Repair the staircase handrail and provide proper railings on both sides.

cases.obs: Water leaking from the pump at the AP3 quenching section.
cases.action: Replace the pump with the standby unit to fix the seal leak, and arrest the leak on the seal cooling line.

cases.obs: Emergency eye wash shower in the AP3 HF storage area not cleaned and missing its protective cover.
cases.action: Clean and maintain the eye wash shower, fit its dust cover and include it in the routine flushing/inspection check.

cases.obs: Drain grating missing at the AP3 pickling section, leaving the drain open and creating a trip and fall hazard.
cases.action: Fit a proper grating over the drain and secure it.

cases.obs: Earth pits 5 to 8 at the AP3 exit-section ECR overdue for periodic resistance testing.
cases.action: Test the earth pits, record the results and update the test date displayed on each pit.

cases.hazard: air pipes and buckets on floor

cases.obs: Cover of the water-line pressure switch on Bell Annealing furnace base-4 found missing.
cases.action: Install a new pressure switch cover and secure it with screws.

cases.obs: Open bucket of oil left on the floor near Bogie Hearth Furnace No. 2.
cases.action: Remove the oil bucket and store waste oil in closed containers at the designated location away from the furnace.

cases.obs: Trench cover damaged at the SMS-2 charging area road drain, creating a trip and fall hazard.
cases.action: Replace the damaged trench cover with a new cover of adequate strength.

cases.obs: Water leaking from the pipeline near the column at CTL flat loading point-2, making the floor slippery.
cases.action: Arrest the water leak, dry the floor and cordon off the wet area until it is safe.

cases.obs: Hydraulic oil leaking from a hydraulic cylinder on 4-Hi Mill-2.
cases.action: Arrest the leak by replacing the cylinder seal and clean up the spilled oil.

cases.obs: Loose sheets left unsecured on the CRD4 project site in windy weather, risking them being blown onto people.
cases.action: Remove loose sheets or tie them down securely, and keep no loose material at site during high winds.

cases.obs: Emergency light in the Bell Annealing basement near base 12 not working.
cases.action: Replace the faulty emergency light and test it.

cases.hazard: access into crane line of fire
cases.obs: During HBA-3 furnace repair, nothing prevents people climbing the brick wall into the line of fire of the EOT crane.
cases.action: Restrict EOT crane movement over the area during furnace repair and revise the method statement to control access to the wall.

cases.obs: Defective welding glove left in the CCP pump house work area, risking hand injury if used.
cases.action: Remove the defective glove from service, replace it with a new one and inspect PPE regularly.

cases.obs: Wire rope sling fallen onto the floor in the CRM maintenance area, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Remove the sling from the floor and store slings on designated hooks or racks.

cases.obs: Electrical and welding cables lying loose across the walkway in the CRM mechanical maintenance area, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Lift the cables off the floor and route them through cable trays, hooks or overhead supports.

cases.obs: Discharge hose of a fire extinguisher at the HRD fire hydrant point found damaged.
cases.action: Replace the damaged extinguisher hose and confirm the extinguisher is serviceable.

cases.obs: No flashback arrestor fitted on the LPG cylinder used for slab cutting at CCS-1.
cases.action: Install a flashback arrestor on the LPG cylinder line before any cutting work resumes.

cases.obs: Several shed lights at the 20-Hi mill not working, resulting in very poor illumination.
cases.action: Replace or repair the faulty lights and verify adequate illumination across the shed.

cases.obs: Sleeves at ST4 line stacked improperly and in excess, so they could fall on people; a similar injury occurred at SPD-1 last month.
cases.action: Remove excess sleeves and store them stably at the designated place within the permitted stack height.

cases.obs: Old, unused control panel of the annealing furnace base left in place in Bell Annealing, obstructing the area.
cases.action: Remove the unused panel, fit a trench cover over the panel opening and clear the area.

cases.obs: Open MCBs, hanging cables and deteriorated connections found in the CRD utility mechanical workshop.
cases.action: Cover and mount the MCBs properly, rectify the deteriorated connections and dress the cables.

cases.obs: Direction markings missing on the pendant push buttons of the 15 t and 5 t CRM cranes.
cases.action: Restore clear direction markings on all pendant push buttons so the cranes are operated correctly.

cases.obs: Oil leaking from the hydraulic power pack at Melting Furnace-1 & 2, with poor housekeeping around it.
cases.action: Rectify the leak at source, clean up the spilled oil and maintain housekeeping.

cases.obs: Oil barrel placed on the safe walkway at the entrance of the roll grinding shop.
cases.action: Move the oil barrel to its designated stand and keep the walkway clear.

cases.hazard: no zero-access guard on rotating part

cases.obs: Steel shots scattered on the safe walkway at the A1 line shot-blasting area, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean up the shots, store them in closed containers at the designated place and avoid spillage while filling the machine.

cases.obs: Pendant cable of EOT crane-26 found loose at the Nobag packing area.
cases.action: Dress and secure the pendant cable properly with its strain support.

cases.obs: Coupling guard missing on the CRD-2 WBA strip drier motor.
cases.action: Provide and fix a guard over the motor coupling.

cases.obs: Open holes found in the PAF ECR ground-floor MCC panel.
cases.action: Close all open holes in the MCC panel with proper blanking plates or cable glands.

cases.obs: Damaged floor near the staircase at the AOD deslagging area, creating a trip and fall hazard.
cases.action: Repair the damaged floor surface near the staircase.

cases.hazard: open dsl panel and loose mcb

cases.obs: Cable near the Sundwig mill laid on the floor without a cable tray.
cases.action: Route and dress the cable properly in a cable tray.

cases.obs: Oil leaking from the CTL machine gearbox near PAF, contaminating the floor.
cases.action: Arrest the gearbox oil leak by replacing the seal or gasket, and clean the area.

cases.obs: Oil leaking from the hydraulic power pack at the plate inspection area.
cases.action: Arrest the hydraulic oil leak and clean the area.

cases.obs: Two high-mounted lights in front of the bloom and slab caster not working, causing low illumination in the cutting area.
cases.action: Replace the faulty lights and verify the lux level in the cutting area.

cases.hazard: waste with sharp objects on floor

cases.obs: Access to fire hydrant point No. 59 at the boiler house blocked by stored materials.
cases.action: Remove the stored materials and keep the hydrant point access clear at all times.

cases.obs: Exposed wire connections found on the charging crane warning hooter at the continuous pickling line.
cases.action: Replace the hooter and terminate its wiring properly inside an enclosed connection box.

cases.obs: No exhaust fan in the mechanical workshop ECR, causing heat to accumulate.
cases.action: Install an exhaust fan in the ECR to ventilate and remove heat.

cases.obs: Water spilled on the shop floor in front of the staircase at the FAFS lime storage area, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean up the water and provide proper drainage to prevent accumulation.

cases.obs: Low illumination in the passage area at the AOD tapping trolley.
cases.action: Provide adequate lighting in the passage area.

cases.obs: MCC/electrical panels at the Z1 mill filtration area covered with plastic tarpaulin and web slings, with combustible material stored on top of live panels.
cases.action: Remove all combustible items from the panels and provide proper protection for the MCC, such as a canopy or suitably rated enclosure.

cases.hazard: no gate at crane access platform

cases.obs: Crane long-travel (LT) rail track found damaged at the shot blasting area.
cases.action: Dismantle the damaged rail, complete the civil foundation work, install a new rail and check crane travel before use.

cases.obs: Long-travel power wheel of Crane No. 65 found loose in its bore during inspection.
cases.action: Replace the loose LT power wheel with a spare wheel and check the crane before returning it to service.

cases.obs: Chain sling left lying on the shop floor at Homogenizing Furnace Area-1.
cases.action: Remove the chain sling and keep it at its designated location.

cases.hazard: damaged wire rope sling in use

cases.obs: Fire point access at Homogenizing Furnace Area-1 blocked by unwanted materials.
cases.action: Remove the materials and keep the fire point access clear at all times.

cases.obs: Earthing strip protruding near the roadway at the Cu-Ni ETP, creating a trip hazard and risk of damage to the earth connection.
cases.action: Replace and re-route the earthing strip, weld it securely to the equipment and protect it from traffic.

cases.obs: Guard missing on the bevel gear at the roughing mill 2-Hi and motor bush pump area.
cases.action: Provide and fix a guard that fully encloses the bevel gear.

cases.obs: Motor coupling guard found damaged at the slitting machine.
cases.action: Repair or replace the coupling guard so the coupling is fully enclosed.

cases.obs: Air-conditioner condensate draining onto the floor near the staircase at the slab unloading area, causing water accumulation and a slip hazard.
cases.action: Repair and re-route the AC drain line to a proper drain so water does not accumulate at the staircase.

cases.hazard: open gap at roll change area
cases.obs: Near miss: a worker's foot slipped into an open gap during roll changing at the roughing mill 2-Hi area.
cases.action: Provide a platform or cover over the gap and brief the roll-change crew on safe working.

cases.obs: Earth pit identification label at the SVC building left blank: no pit number, connected equipment, test date, resistance value or due date.
cases.action: Test the earth pit and fill in all label fields: pit number, connected equipment, test date, resistance value and due date.

cases.obs: Oil spillage on the floor behind the Slitting Line-1 recoiler, creating a slip hazard.
cases.action: Clean up the spilled oil and rectify the source of the leak.

cases.obs: Hand gloves and a helmet placed on top of the CCP Line-1 withdrawal panel, creating a fire hazard.
cases.action: Remove the items from the panel and instruct operators to keep panel tops clear.

cases.obs: Heavy mill roller and stacked items completely obstructing the walkway at the AP-4 annealing section.
cases.action: Move the roller and items to their designated storage and keep the walkway clear.

cases.obs: Cut-out opening in the safeguarding of the running line at AP-4 entry side leaves moving parts accessible.
cases.action: Close the cut-out with a fixed guard so the running line cannot be reached.

cases.obs: Unprotected cut-out floor opening near the staircase at the AP-4 entry section.
cases.action: Cover the opening with a secured plate or guard it with a railing.

cases.obs: Trench cover removed at the AP-4 pickling section, leaving the trench open.
cases.action: Refit the trench cover, or barricade the opening whenever work is not in progress.

cases.obs: Control panel door of Holding Furnace-2 found open.
cases.action: Repair the panel door so it closes and latches properly, and keep it closed.

cases.obs: Earthing trench covers not fitted properly and uneven floor surface at Melting Furnace-3, creating trip hazards.
cases.action: Refit and secure the trench covers and level the floor surface.

cases.obs: Top cable-entry hole of the Bell Furnace Base-2 power connection junction box left open with its rubber cover missing, allowing dust ingress.
cases.action: Fit a rubber cover or cable gland to seal the junction box cable entry.

cases.obs: Polyethylene plastic sheets stored over and around the punching press electrical panel, creating a fire hazard.
cases.action: Remove all plastic sheets from the panel and keep the area around it free of combustibles.

cases.hazard: guarding not used on running line

cases.obs: Weight trolley and power cable left in the walkway at the CCP pulverizer area, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Remove the trolley and cable from the walkway and keep the route clear.

cases.hazard: oil on floor, no drip tray
cases.obs: Oil spreading on the floor under the slit unloader because no drip tray is installed.
cases.action: Install a drip tray under the slit unloader to collect excess oil and clean the floor.

cases.obs: No guard or barricade around the moving coil path between the uncoiler and straightener at Press 1.
cases.action: Provide a fixed guard or barricade to prevent access to the coil path between the uncoiler and straightener.

cases.obs: Pipeline protruding into the access to the drinking-water area in the plate godown, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Remove the redundant pipe or secure it clear of the walkway.

cases.hazard: open cable trench at control desk

cases.obs: Wooden pallets lying in front of the stairs at the CCS-1 ingot casting pit, creating a fall hazard.
cases.action: Remove the pallets and keep the stair access clear.

cases.obs: Trench cover of the old sump pit at HBA-2 entry section found open.
cases.action: Provide and fit a secure cover over the sump pit trench.

cases.obs: Trench cover at HBA-1 entry section not refitted properly after work.
cases.action: Align and fit the trench cover properly after every job.

cases.obs: Fan cover of the new sump pit pump motor at HBA-2 entry found open, exposing the rotating fan.
cases.action: Refit the motor fan cover securely.

cases.obs: Access to fire hydrant point No. 78 at ST5 line blocked by core sleeves.
cases.action: Shift the core sleeves out of the marked hydrant access area.

cases.obs: Damaged floor plates at several locations on the crane gantry platform near the descaling ECR, risking structural failure and falls from height.
cases.action: Barricade the platform with warning signs, then repair or replace all damaged plates with plates of the required thickness and strength.

cases.obs: Edge protection completely missing along the existing press area at the lime kiln, exposing people to a fall from height.
cases.action: Install edge-protection railing along all open edges of the press area.

cases.obs: Railing missing on the EOT crane platform at the lime kiln, creating a serious fall-from-height risk.
cases.action: Install a proper guardrail along all open edges of the EOT platform immediately.

cases.obs: Gas cutting hoses and welding cables lying on the floor at Homogenizing Furnace Area-1, creating trip hazards.
cases.action: Route the hoses and cables clear of walkways and store them at their assigned place when not in use.

cases.obs: HT VCB panels at the AP-2 entry ECR covered with plastic sheet because of roof water leakage through a damaged ceiling, creating fire and flashover risk.
cases.action: Arrest the roof leakage points, repair the ceiling and remove the plastic cover from the VCB panels.

cases.obs: Motor coupling guard missing at PTF-5.
cases.action: Provide and fix a guard over the motor coupling.

cases.obs: Coupling guard on the scrap winder (bundle) motor at ST-6 found loose and not fixed in place.
cases.action: Fix the coupling guard securely on the scrap winder motor.

cases.obs: Temporary cables on the main pump house clarifier bridge tied to the handrail, with taped joints hanging over the water tank and exposed conductors.
cases.action: Isolate and remove the jointed temporary cables; replace with a continuous cable on proper supports, away from the handrail and water.

cases.obs: Loose, unattended ladder placed over the clarifier tank at the main pump house.
cases.action: Remove the ladder; use only secured ladders or fixed platforms for access over the tank.

cases.obs: Chemical mixing agitator at the main pump house guarded only by a temporary bucket instead of a proper guard.
cases.action: Provide a proper fixed guard over the agitator drive.

cases.hazard: loose extension board, no plug top

cases.obs: Support pipes of the deck structure at the P5 line shot-blasting area erected without base-plate anchor bolts.
cases.action: Anchor the base plates with bolts or, where inserts prevent anchoring, weld the supports securely at multiple levels and verify stability.

cases.obs: Guard missing on a rotating shaft at the P5 line shot blasting area.
cases.action: Provide and fix a guard that fully encloses the rotating shaft.

cases.obs: Heavy hydraulic oil leakage from the exit seal-roll gearbox at PTF-8.
cases.action: Arrest the gearbox oil leak and clean the area.

cases.obs: Railing missing at the ST4 online packing machine, creating a fall hazard.
cases.action: Refit and weld the railing securely.

cases.obs: Debris, rags and waste left on the MHME workshop floor, creating slip and trip hazards.
cases.action: Restrict access until cleaned, remove all waste to designated bins and inspect the surrounding area.

cases.obs: Guard covers missing over the brake drum and encoder of the 4-Hi mill DTR motor.
cases.action: Refit guard covers over the brake drum and encoder and tighten them securely.

cases.obs: Gas cylinder trolley blocking access to the fire extinguisher stand at the CCP scrap storage.
cases.action: Move the cylinder trolley away and keep the extinguisher stand access clear.

cases.obs: Exhaust fan blade found broken on the mill motor ventilation system.
cases.action: Isolate the fan and replace the broken blade with a new one.

cases.obs: Panel door lock missing in the 4-Hi mill ECR.
cases.action: Provide a lock on the panel door to prevent unauthorised access.

cases.obs: Wooden boxes left on the road at the CCS-1 ingot casting refractory storage area.
cases.action: Remove the wooden material from the road and store it at the designated place.

cases.obs: Construction debris and scrap rebars scattered on the road near the CCS-1 hot well pump house, creating a trip hazard.
cases.action: Clear the debris and rebars from the road and dispose of them at the designated scrap area.

cases.obs: Material kept in front of the stairs at the SGL-2 top heads, obstructing access.
cases.action: Clear the stair access and instruct the team to store material only at its designated place.

cases.obs: MCB box at PTF-3 without its protection cover, leaving the MCB and MPCB open.
cases.action: Replace the MCB box or fit a proper protection cover over the MCB and MPCB.

cases.obs: No fall protection installed on the crane gantry platform near the Steckel Mill primary descaling area.
cases.action: Install guardrails on the gantry platform, and issue PTW for gantry work only after fall protection is verified.

cases.obs: Hydraulic oil leaking from the SGL hydraulic pump, with oil lying on the floor.
cases.action: Arrest the hydraulic leak at the pump and clean the oil from the floor.

cases.obs: Hand grinder at the PTF-10 entry section used without its side handle.
cases.action: Fit the side handle on the grinder before use and brief users to check it.

cases.obs: Inadequate illumination on the stairs to the EAF-1 first-floor control room.
cases.action: Install adequate lighting on the stairs and verify the lux level.

cases.obs: Depression in the road at the SMS-1 charging area growing daily, in an area of heavy loader movement.
cases.action: Patch and level the depressed road surface.

cases.obs: DANGER sign and control knob missing on an electrical panel near Slitting Line-6.
cases.action: Display a DANGER sign on the panel and fit the missing control knob.

cases.obs: Oil leaking at the AOD top lance platform.
cases.action: Arrest the oil leak and protect the line with insulation.

cases.obs: Trench cover damaged at the EAF fume extraction system, creating a fall hazard.
cases.action: Replace the damaged trench cover with a new cover plate.

cases.obs: Discarded grinding wheels at the Daniele grinder shift office not kept in their stand.
cases.action: Store discarded grinding wheels in the designated stand.

cases.obs: Scrap bins at the Daniele grinder maintenance area unidentified and overflowing.
cases.action: Empty the bins and colour-code them by scrap type (e.g. grey for SS, black for MS).

cases.obs: Material kept in the access to the hydrant post at the PTF-10 entry section.
cases.action: Remove the material and keep the hydrant post access clear.

cases.obs: No guide handles provided on the C-hooks at the Frohling 4-Hi mill.
cases.action: Weld guide handles on all C-hooks so they can be steered without hand contact with the load.

cases.obs: HT cables outside the 132 kV substation area exposed to damage from project materials stored close by.
cases.action: Protect the HT cables with a cover and relocate the stored project materials away from them.

cases.obs: Excessive load swing observed on Crane No. 7 during coil shifting at the Sundwig mill.
cases.action: Adjust the LT brake setting and consider an anti-sway system for safe coil handling.
